stem:
Pihu wants a fair comparison of lemon juice and soap water using one prepared hibiscus extract as the indicator. Lemon juice and soap water start with different colours. She has a dropper and will record final colours so she can later label each sample acid or base.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Using the same hibiscus extract, similar drop amounts of each sample, and recording both final colours makes the comparison fair.
Using one drop of lemon juice and ten drops of soap water is fair if the indicator is the same and both final colours are recorded.
Different starting colours of lemon juice and soap water do not make the comparison unfair when both final colours are clearly readable.

teacher.key_rationale: Fairness needs the same indicator, comparable amounts, and recorded final colours. Unequal drops are unfair. Different starting colours alone do not make a readable final-colour comparison unfair.
